MoSJE Website DBIM DS — Defect Fixes, 5 Oct 2026

Figma file xdv8nEd7PhnRhahASd9UPY. Each “before” was captured before any edit; each “after” from the same node at the same size.

D1Document list row — date and file type

The date and “PDF” labels were set in Inter with no text style. They are now Noto Sans Small Text 1 Regular, which reaches 216 labels on the screens.

DBIM §4.1: Noto Sans only.

D3Text links at Heading 2 and Heading 3 size

Heading 3 links were Regular; Heading 2 links were Regular with no style. Both are now Medium (heading-3-medium, heading-2-medium).

DBIM Table 3: H2 and H3 take Bold, Semi Bold or Medium only.

D3Footer (desktop and mobile)

The footer links are Heading 3 text links, so they move from Regular to Medium. No label wraps differently and nothing overflows.

Same rule; the footer is on every page.

D8PM Quote — citation and date

The citation was set in all capitals. It is now sentence case (Paragraph 1 Regular).

DBIM §4.1.1 ii: no all-caps for long sentences.

D8Ministry › Our Team — office header bars

The blue bar titles (“Union Cabinet Minister of Social Justice & Empowerment”) were in capitals; they are now sentence case (Paragraph 1 Bold). The small designations inside the photo cards were not changed — see the note below.

DBIM §4.1.1 ii.

D2“Back to Dr. Ambedkar International Centre” link

This link carried Paragraph 1 Semi Bold, a pair the manual does not allow. It now uses the link's own Paragraph 1 Regular.

DBIM Table 3: P1 takes Bold or Regular.

D4Persona tile text

The text was raw black #000000; it is now bound to Deep Earthy Brown (text/default). The difference is barely visible, by design.

DBIM §2.2: black is the emblem's colour; text is Deep Earthy Brown.

D7Icons — File Copy, Visibility, Warning, Hide Image, School, Temple Buddhist, and Search for reference (24 / 32 / 48 / 64)

Six glyphs ran into the 2px padding at 24 and 32. All 80 icons now keep exactly 2px at every size, so the live area is 20 / 28 / 44 / 60. Glyphs at 32, 48 and 64 grow 5%, 10% and 12.5% to fill it.
